target: Make embedded-audit proofs under proof/pr_merge/** visible to every deterministic validation route, and remove the false-success path from the local signing wrapper, so that neither a proof the canonical schema rejects nor an unsigned/stale-signed proof can pass unexamined — without converting unrelated legacy proof debt into an unbounded repair campaign.
invariants: SCOPE: this packet exists because FOUR independent routes under-enforce on proof/pr_merge/**, three of them filters and one a signing wrapper. (1) proof/.validator_scope.json sets include_patterns to proof/TP-DMX-*/PROOF.json with default_when_unmatched: skip_with_warning. (2) The pre-commit proof hook matches only a single directory under proof/ — files pattern proof/<one-dir>/PROOF.json — so nested proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/pr-<N>/ never matches. (3) scripts/governance/validate_change_contract.py strips the report_path pattern from the trusted schema before validating any path starting with proof/pr_merge/. (4) scripts/audit/sign_local_audit_proof.sh can report success when no new signature was written. Closing any one of these leaves the others open.

EVIDENCE: every item is a confirmed defect, not a hypothesis. (1)+(2) PR #1165 published a proof whose report_path violated the trusted schema pattern; a direct scripts/audit/validate_audit_proof.py run rejected it while CI stayed green, because neither filter looked. (3) Confirmed on trusted main at 5d694cc9898e5046b5da03319f20f48599c40ca8, scripts/governance/validate_change_contract.py lines 245-251, and raised independently as review thread #8 on PR #1165. (4) Confirmed during the PR #1165 round-4 signing: with a stale .sig present, ssh-keygen prompts before overwrite, EOF declines the prompt, the old signature survives untouched, and the wrapper still prints 'signed: <path>.sig'.

PRE-EXISTING, NOT INTRODUCED: defect (3) is present on trusted main and is NOT touched by PR #1165. Its correct disposition is this separated packet, not a widening of #1165. Do not describe it as a regression introduced by the embedded-audit repair series.

NOT ALREADY FIXED: repairing scripts/audit/local_audit_acceptance.py to execute the canonical schema (TP-DMX-AUDIT-AGY-GEMINI31-APPROVAL-001-REPAIR-001, steps R07 and the round-4 required=true restoration) closes the signed local-attestation route ONLY. It does not make the deterministic sweep, pre-commit, or the changed-contract preflight look at proof/pr_merge/**, and it does not touch the signing wrapper. Do not report this packet's work as done by that repair.

STALE JUSTIFYING COMMENT: the softening in validate_change_contract.py is justified in-code by the comment 'Local acceptance intentionally skips report_path for pr_merge'. That statement is FALSE as of TP-DMX-AUDIT-AGY-GEMINI31-APPROVAL-001-REPAIR-001, which removed the report_path exemption from local acceptance. Removing the softening must also remove or correct the comment, so the next reader does not restore it on the strength of an obsolete rationale.

BOUNDED BLAST RADIUS: widening validator scope will surface pre-existing nonconformant proofs. Enumerate them first and classify each as REPAIR / QUARANTINE / DOCUMENTED-LEGACY before changing any default. A scope widening that turns CI red across unrelated history is a failed execution of this packet, not a success.
NO SILENT SKIPS: default_when_unmatched: skip_with_warning is the mechanism that produced the false green. Any retained skip must be an explicit, enumerated, reviewed entry — never a fallthrough.

FAIL CLOSED: an unmatched or unreadable proof must not be reported as PASS. A sweep that validates nothing must not exit 0 with a green summary. A signer that wrote no signature must not exit 0 with a success line.

NO GATE WEAKENING: this packet must not weaken signature verification, allowed-signers trust, namespace binding, repository or PR identity, audited-head ancestry, proof-only successor closure, passing-verdict policy, the embedded_audit.required=true acceptance policy, or PR Steward semantics.

SCHEMA VALIDITY AND ACCEPTANCE POLICY REMAIN DISTINCT: schemas/proof/embedded_audit.schema.json is the only authority on embedded_audit shape, and it is deliberately more permissive than acceptance because it also describes CI-emitted diagnostic proofs. Gates the schema cannot express live in local_audit_acceptance.policy_errors() and are pinned by POLICY_ONLY_REJECTIONS. Do not introduce a second hand-written structural validator, and do not migrate a policy gate into the schema to make it 'consistent'.
SINGLE POLICY ENGINE: extend coverage, not the number of implementations. Every route that validates an embedded_audit object must execute the canonical schema rather than approximate it.

commit.message: fix(audit): validator-scope parity for proof/pr_merge proofs and fail-closed local signing

pr.title: fix(audit): validator-scope parity for proof/pr_merge embedded-audit proofs and fail-closed local signing
pr.body: Closes the sweep, pre-commit, and changed-contract-preflight blind spots that let a schema-invalid embedded-audit proof pass CI green, and removes the false-success path from the local signing wrapper. Enumerates existing nonconformance before widening scope, so the change does not convert legacy proof debt into an unbounded repair campaign.

steps.task: Enumerate the true blast radius before changing any configuration.
requirements: Run scripts/audit/validate_audit_proof.py directly against every PROOF.json under proof/, including proof/pr_merge/**, with no scope filtering.
Produce a census of conforming and nonconforming bundles with the exact schema error for each.
Classify every nonconforming bundle as REPAIR, QUARANTINE, or DOCUMENTED-LEGACY with a stated reason.
Do not change proof/.validator_scope.json, .pre-commit-config.yaml, or scripts/governance/validate_change_contract.py in this step.

steps.task: Bring proof/pr_merge/** into deterministic validation scope with an explicit, enumerated disposition for every pre-existing failure.
requirements: Add proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/** to the sweep's include patterns.
Replace default_when_unmatched: skip_with_warning with a fail-closed default, or justify in writing why it must remain and enumerate every path that relies on it.

Extend the pre-commit proof hook's files pattern to cover the same path family, including nested directories — the current pattern matches only a single directory under proof/, which is why proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/pr-<N>/PROOF.json never matched.
Any retained exemption must be an explicit enumerated entry with a reason, never a silent fallthrough.

steps.task: Remove the report_path softening from the changed-contract preflight so it stops issuing false green for proof/pr_merge proofs.
requirements: In scripts/governance/validate_change_contract.py, delete the branch that copies the trusted schema and pops report_path.pattern for paths beginning with proof/pr_merge/ (lines 245-251 as of 5d694cc9898e5046b5da03319f20f48599c40ca8), so the preflight validates the unmodified canonical schema.
Remove or correct the justifying comment 'Local acceptance intentionally skips report_path for pr_merge' — it is obsolete, because local acceptance no longer skips report_path.

Confirm against the S01 census that removing the softening does not red-line any bundle whose disposition was not already classified; if it does, handle it under that classification rather than by restoring the exemption.
Do not add a compensating exemption elsewhere. If a legacy proof genuinely cannot conform, it must be an enumerated QUARANTINE entry, not a pattern-stripping branch.

steps.task: Make the local signing wrapper fail closed, so it cannot report success without having written a new signature.
requirements: In scripts/audit/sign_local_audit_proof.sh, ensure an existing .sig cannot be silently retained: either remove/relocate it before invoking ssh-keygen, or pass a non-interactive mode, so ssh-keygen is never left at an overwrite prompt that EOF declines.
After signing, verify the produced signature over the exact PROOF.json bytes with ssh-keygen -Y verify against config/audit/embedded-audit-allowed-signers, and exit non-zero if verification fails.
Assert the signature file's modification identity actually changed — comparing content hashes before and after is sufficient — and exit non-zero if it did not.
The success line must be printed only after verification succeeds, never before, and never on a path where no signature was written.
Document in docs/ops/embedded-audit-proof.md that wrapper stdout is not evidence of signing and that ssh-keygen -Y verify over the committed bytes is the controlling check.

steps.task: Pin the scope contract with regression tests so a future narrowing is caught rather than discovered by a false green.
requirements: Assert that a proof placed under proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/ is validated rather than skipped.
Assert that an unmatched proof path fails closed and is not reported as PASS.
Assert that the pre-commit hook pattern, the sweep include patterns, and the changed-contract preflight cover the same path family, so the routes cannot drift apart again.
Assert that the changed-contract preflight rejects a proof/pr_merge proof whose report_path violates the canonical pattern — the exact case the softening used to admit.
Assert that the signing wrapper exits non-zero when a stale .sig is present and no new signature is written.
Record in docs/ops/embedded-audit-proof.md which routes validate which paths, and state the historical false-green plainly.
